description: 50 original downloadable MP3 recordings by Kevin MacLeod, 10 per source genre. Ten application-created demo compilations are labels for browsing, not official releases. Source genres map Electronica to electronic; other genre names are unchanged.

rights.modifications: None. Download and upload the original MP3 bytes.
rights.distribution_note: Keep a visible track credit or Credits screen containing title, artist, source, license URL, and changes. Do not impose DRM or contractual restrictions on the CC-licensed recordings. Subscription entitlements must not remove the CC rights of recipients.
rights.recording_note: Kevin MacLeod is credited as recording artist; public-domain compositions remain distinct from his licensed recordings.
